panels.title: Stale sprint count per project
panels.description: S39 / S35 pair: sprints currently in status=STALE, broken down by project.

targets.rawSql: SELECT p.name AS metric, count(*)::int AS value FROM sprints s JOIN projects p ON p.id = s.project_id WHERE s.status = 'STALE' GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY value DESC;

panels.title: Total STALE sprints
panels.description: S39: overall count of sprints currently marked STALE by S35 reaper.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*)::int AS value FROM sprints WHERE status = 'STALE';

panels.title: Top-20 most recently marked STALE
panels.description: S39: top-20 sprints by most-recent stale transition (updated_at), with age since sprint started.

targets.rawSql: SELECT s.id, p.name AS project, s.name AS sprint, s.updated_at AS marked_stale_at, round((EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - COALESCE(s.actual_start, s.created_at)))/3600)::numeric, 1) AS active_age_hours FROM sprints s JOIN projects p ON p.id = s.project_id WHERE s.status = 'STALE' ORDER BY s.updated_at DESC LIMIT 20;

panels.title: SprintStaleDetected alerts over time (last 7d)
panels.description: S39: volume of SprintStaleDetected alerts from legion_alerts, bucketed by hour and ecosystem project.

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('hour', created_at) AS time, ecosystem_project AS metric, count(*)::int AS value FROM legion_alerts WHERE alertname = 'SprintStaleDetected' AND created_at > now() - interval '7 days' GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1;
